title: 数値シミュレーション
subtitle: Numerical Simulation
keywords: Numerical simulation 2.Structural analysis 3.Aerodynamic analysis 4.Finite element method 5.Local collaboration
educationalGoal: With the rapid development of computers, numerical simulations for structural analysis and aerodynamic analysis are essential in the aircraft design process. In this practical training course, students will learn how to properly use numerical simulation for structural mechanics and fluid dynamics in the aircraft design process. Students will also learn how to utilize numerical simulation to solve actual engineering problems that occur in their local community.
advice: In this course, students will learn numerical analysis through the use of numerical analysis software. We will cover the following materials: 1 Introduction to numerical simulation 2 Structural analysis Geometrical modeling, Finite element modeling, Load and constraint conditions, Execution of analysis, Evaluation of results, Comparison with theoretical result 3 Aerodynamic analysis Geometry modelling, Meshing, Computational method, Initial and boundary conditions, Execution of analysis, Evaluation of results, Comparison with experimental results Lectures on structural analysis and aerodynamic analysis will be given separately in the first half and the second half of semester. The order of the two lectures may change. A fixed schedule will be announced in the first lecture of the semester.
books: Required materials will be specified in the first lesson.
requiredKnowledge: It is recommended that students have already taken the following courses: Mechanics of Materials, Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics, 3D-CAD, Aerodynamics for Aircraft A, Applied Mathematics, and Computer Engineering. In structural analysis, we will use the textbook specified above. In aerodynamic analysis, the textbook will be handed out during the class.

activityGoals.body: Be able to analyze deformation and stress of a basic structure by using standard numerical analysis software
Be able to conduct basic flaw field by using standard numerical analysis software
Be able to explain factors that affect analysis results
Be able to obtain information from analysis results to understand the stress field or the flow field

achievementLevels.ideal: [Structural analysis] In the analysis of a flat plate with a semicircular notch, accurately evaluate the effect of mesh division on the analysis results. In the analysis of a box beam, evaluate the analysis results based on knowledge of mechanics of materials. [Aerodynamic analysis] In analysis of a 2D circular cylinder, set up a suitable boundary condition and recognize the influence of meshing on the computational result. In analysis of airfoil shapes, accurately compute the pressure distribution, lift, drag, and moment. In addition, evaluate the computational results based on knowledge of aerodynamics.
achievementLevels.standard: [Structural analysis] In analysis of a flat plate with a semicircular notch, evaluate the effect of mesh division on the analysis results. In analysis of a box beam, accurately calculate the deformation and stress. [Aerodynamic analysis] In analysis of a 2D circular cylinder, explain a suitable boundary condition and the influence of meshing on the computational result. In analysis of airfoil shapes, accurately compute the pressure distribution, lift, drag and moment.
